purpose: Frozen Epoch30 goal distribution -> original10000 proposals ->19KMeans+1softargmax audit; no training/new algorithm
sampler: Immutable Stage11B-1R sample_cpu and cluster_proposals,stable SHA sample_id seeds
p_mass: float64 mathematical p=w_original_float32/sum_float64(w),offline analysis only; original weights/draws untouched
raw_probability: Sigmoid is unnormalized weight; no calibrated uncertainty claim
hit_formula: -expm1(10000*log1p(-P_mass)); mass0=>0,1=>1; iid replacement theoretical probability,not actual hit
low_mass_reference: P_hit<0.5 analytic reference,not tuned to errors

named_types.T2: A and not B (may overlap T5)
named_types.T6: outside union T1..T5; impossible A0 B1 flagged

fixed_A25: Original164 minGoalFDE20>25 IDs; same164 denominator at all radii

case_selection.rule: Within each exclusive category sort sample_id; ranks floor(q*(N-1)) for q=.25,.5,.75; deduplicate ranks; absent types no case

plot_contract.conclusion: Locate observed frozen-chain coverage changes without causal or novelty claims

limitations: centers and softargmax need not be samples
mechanism_priority_rule: Descriptive unique largest category among final A25 failures must also be unique largest in deathCircle and other4 pooled, and occur in>=3recordings; ties/mixed=>MECHANISM_INCONCLUSIVE. Not a statistical test or innovation GO.
